verdict.rationale: mParticle's docs advertise transforming data as it enters and leaves the platform (mparticle-docs-8, title only). They also document in-pipeline filtering through consent filters and forwarding rules, such as 'Do not forward if CCPA Data sale opt out is present' (mparticle-docs-21, mparticle-docs-x3). Nothing in the pack shows that engineers can write custom code or functions for transformation or enrichment. Missing for 10: evidence of custom code/function-based transforms, documented enrichment capabilities, detail beyond a page title on transformation mechanics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
